description: Slow wear processes (card M4-01, P Part 4 Step 4.1). Each grows the severity of a registry fault (0..1, the registry's own parameter effects) over operating hours, scaled by its stressor. Rates are ASSUMED (no public wear data for these engines): chosen so a healthy tail reaches severity 1 in a few hundred to a few thousand flight hours. Per-tail spread: lognormal multiplier.

tail_rate_sigma.ref: lognormal sigma of the per-tail rate multiplier (manufacturing and usage spread)

processes.ref: ANUMAAN wear laws from P Step 4.1; rate = severity per flight hour at stress 1
